pages.text: $(l)Avoid common early mistakes$()$(li)A ritual won’t start if the required activation crystal is missing—even if you have enough blood$(li)The Dagger of Sacrifice must deal full damage to mobs;
mechanical users dealing only 1 HP won’t trigger sacrifice$(li)Blood orbs don’t stack their absorption rate multiplicatively—multiple Self Sacrifice runes add linearly

$(l)Upgrade path tips$()$(li)Replace an Apprentice Orb with a Sacrifice or Demon Orb once you can craft it; higher tiers absorb blood faster$(li)For a next-step setup, consider the T6 tri-altar layout (Sacrifice, Crafting, Charging) in a 23×23×9 footprint
